evidence_candidates.excerpt: The HotNets paper argues that CXL pools can fail to produce net datacenter benefit because added switching and cabling cost can outweigh multiplexing savings, higher latency requires application or system complexity, and existing server-scale scheduling can already reduce stranded memory.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: CXL pooling should be evaluated against a scheduler-only baseline and total fabric cost; reduced stranded capacity does not by itself establish a positive system-level case.
